name: opencode-condense
description: Verbatim, scorer-guided context compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum scorer probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum scorer state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every scorer request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum scorer request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one scorer request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when the scorer decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

model.title: Scorer model
model.description: Scorer model name (reference endpoint: TypeSafe jev-latest).
